parts.html: Basic Interior Design Package — €35–45/m²

DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) offers the Basic Interior Design Package for apartments, private houses, and commercial spaces where a complete interior concept and a full set of technical documentation for renovation works are required.
The package combines space planning, photorealistic 3D visualizations, and the main working drawings needed by the construction team to implement the developed interior.

It is an optimal solution if the property is at the pre-renovation stage or requires replanning, positioning of engineering outlets, lighting, plumbing, finishing materials, and other elements of the future interior.
As a result, you can see in advance how the space will look after renovation and receive the technical basis required for its implementation.
What Is Included in the Basic Package
1. Measured Floor Plan

Before the design process begins, the main dimensions of the space, walls, openings, windows, doors, utilities, and other architectural elements are recorded. The measured floor plan becomes the basis for the further development of the interior design project.
2. Furniture Layout Plan

A functional layout is developed with the placement of furniture, plumbing fixtures, and key interior elements. The planning takes into account room dimensions, circulation, ergonomics, storage systems, and how the space will be used.
3. Demolition and Construction Plans

If required, drawings are prepared showing the demolition of existing structures and the construction of new partitions. This allows the construction team to clearly understand which changes must be carried out on site.
4. Plumbing Layout Plan
The location of plumbing fixtures and the required utility connections is defined. Bathrooms, kitchens, laundry rooms, and other areas requiring plumbing connections are carefully planned.
5. Underfloor Heating Plan
If required, a layout of electric or other project-specified underfloor heating zones is prepared, taking into account the position of furniture and plumbing fixtures.
6. Sockets and Electrical Outlets Plan

A layout of sockets, electrical outlets, and appliance connection points is developed. Electrical planning takes into account the future placement of furniture, kitchen equipment, televisions, work areas, and other appliances.
7. Switches Plan
The location of switches and the main lighting control scenarios are defined. This makes lighting more convenient to use and allows all necessary electrical points to be planned in advance.
8. Lighting Plan

A layout of the main and decorative light sources is developed. Depending on the interior concept, the project may include ceiling lights, track lighting, pendant lights, wall lights, LED lighting, and other solutions.
9. Ceiling Plan
A ceiling layout is developed taking into account lighting, built-in elements, and the architecture of the space.
10. Flooring Plan

The types and boundaries of flooring materials, laying directions, and transitions between different finishes are defined. This allows parquet, engineered wood, tiles, porcelain stoneware, and other materials to be coordinated in advance.
11. Kitchen and Bathroom Wall Elevations

For areas with a large number of built-in elements and engineering systems, the required wall elevations are prepared. These drawings help define the exact position of furniture, plumbing fixtures, tiles, sockets, equipment, and other elements.
12. Specifications and Material Schedules

The project includes information about the main finishing materials used in the approved interior concept. This helps both the client and the construction team understand which materials are required for implementation.
3D Visualization of Each Room

Photorealistic 3D visualizations are developed for each main room. They allow you to see the future interior before renovation begins and evaluate the combination of materials, furniture, lighting, colors, and decorative elements.
3D visualization helps approve the interior before the solutions are implemented on site. The package includes one round of revisions to the developed concept.
Technical Documentation for Renovation

One of the key advantages of the Basic Package is the set of working drawings. After the layout and interior concept are approved, the designer prepares technical documentation that is passed on to the construction team.

This connects the visual interior concept with the actual renovation process. The contractors receive clear information about the position of partitions, plumbing, electrical systems, lighting, ceilings, flooring, and other project elements.
As a result, fewer decisions need to be made directly during the renovation process.
What Types of Properties Is the Basic Package Suitable For?
The package can be used for apartments in new developments, resale apartments, private houses, apartments for investment, offices, beauty salons, shops, showrooms, and small commercial spaces.
Each project is developed individually, taking into account the architecture of the property, its size, function, and the client’s requirements.
Who Is the Basic Package For?

The package is an optimal choice if your apartment or house is about to undergo renovation, you need to create a new interior from scratch, develop a convenient layout, define furniture placement in advance, plan electrical systems and lighting, determine the position of plumbing fixtures, select finishing materials, and prepare working drawings for the construction team.
It is also suitable for clients who want to see their future interior through 3D visualizations and receive a complete design project without an extended project management package.
What You Receive

As a result, you receive a complete interior design project including a functional space-planning solution, furniture layout, an approved stylistic concept, photorealistic 3D visualizations, electrical and lighting plans, plumbing layouts, ceiling and flooring plans, required wall elevations, and a set of technical documentation for renovation works.
This means the interior design project becomes not only a visual concept but also a practical tool for implementing the interior.
Basic Interior Design Package Price
€35–45/m²
Minimum package price — €2,000.
The final price depends on the size of the property, number of rooms, complexity of the layout, and the amount of technical documentation required.
Additional Services

If required, the Basic Interior Design Package can be supplemented with other DUMSKAYA DESIGN services, including design supervision, preparation of a detailed renovation cost estimate, project procurement, furniture, lighting and decor selection, custom furniture design, production of kitchens, wardrobes and other built-in furniture, furniture delivery and installation, as well as turnkey renovation.
This allows you to continue working with one contractor after the design stage and move directly to the implementation of the interior.
Interior Design and Project Implementation

DUMSKAYA DESIGN works with residential and commercial properties, developing interiors from initial space planning and visual concepts to technical documentation, custom furniture, and complete project implementation.
The studio’s main geographic focus is Bratislava and Vienna. We also work on projects in other cities across Europe and the USA.
